title: Anxiety & Stress Management
description: Learn practical tools to manage anxiety, reduce stress, and develop coping strategies for life's challenges. Primary specialty for all ages.

title: Relationship Stress
description: Improve communication, resolve conflicts, and build healthier connections in all your relationships. Primary specialty for individuals, families, and couples.

title: Family Dynamics
description: Strengthen family bonds, improve communication, and resolve conflicts using systemic family therapy approaches.

title: Couples Therapy
description: Build stronger partnerships through improved communication, emotional connection, and conflict resolution using EFT approaches.

title: Teen & Preteen Support
description: Support young people (ages 10-18) through developmental challenges, identity formation, and emotional regulation.

title: Trauma-Focused Therapy
description: Heal from past experiences using specialized trauma-focused approaches in a safe, supportive therapeutic environment.

title: Life Transitions
description: Navigate major life changes with support and guidance through career shifts, relationship changes, and personal growth.

title: Christian Counseling
description: Integrate faith and spirituality into your healing journey when desired, honoring your beliefs and values.
